title: Release
description: A Part-145 organization re-certifies the part fit for service after repair or overhaul (FAA 8130-3 / EASA Form 1). A claim, not a confirmation - whether the organization's own approval backs it is answered by its entity trust level (OWM-6), not by this schema (spec Sec.6).

cycles_used.description: Cumulative flight cycles as of this release, for a life-limited part.
